schema_version: 1
name: ms-go-teacher-agent
kind: go_backend_service
purpose: Decide how a persistent personal programming teacher should guide a student without owning student learning state.
owns:
  - bounded diagnostic Placement presentation and explicit planning delegation with durable owner-state recovery
  - PersonalTeacher identity and behavior settings
  - one independently versioned TeacherSoul per PersonalTeacher/student pair
  - teacher orchestration and pedagogical policies
  - bounded StudentContext construction
  - explainable teacher decisions and intervention state
  - teacher-owned learning-action assistance summaries
  - deterministic learning-session summary orchestration and next-step policy
  - per-student Telegram account binding and durable channel delivery state
  - LLM orchestration behind a port
  - deterministic product-aware onboarding prompt and readiness-response policy
  - durable state-fenced onboarding plan-handoff dispatch and deterministic Dialog notification checkpoints
  - read-only authoritative Student Next Best Action presentation and deterministic Dialog explanation
does_not_own:
  - student knowledge, mastery, evidence projections, learning paths, or learning sessions
  - dialog history
  - canonical course content or knowledge graph
  - raw analytics events
  - sandbox execution or validation truth
stack: [Go, chi, pgx, PostgreSQL, NATS JetStream]
entrypoint: cmd/ms-go-teacher-agent/main.go
dependencies:
  postgres: required
  nats: durable TASKANSWER_EVENTS, DIALOG_EVENTS, LEARNING_ANALYTICS_EVENTS, and LEARNING_PLANNER_EVENTS consumers plus TEACHER_EVENTS producer for teacher.decision.recorded and teacher.assistance.observed
  student_http: bounded learner overview for general and lesson dialogs, exact frozen assigned lesson context for v2, plus LearningAction, secret-safe code context, exact target mastery, and authoritative computed Next Best Action for read-only NBA
  practice_http: exact active task-instance Teacher context, optional bounded validation explanation for practice_task only, plus idempotent assistance recording for practice_task and project dialogs
  course_http: current active lesson content used transiently for v1 exact revision and selected-text verification only; v2 uses Student frozen assignment
  learning_planner_http: dedicated Teacher course-plan intent, strict state-fenced onboarding readiness read, and dedicated state-fenced onboarding admission command; graph, gap, generation, assignment, executable planning, and path mutation remain Planner-owned
  dialog: durable dialog.teacher.requested consumer plus bounded read and idempotent response append
  ai_prompt: confidential teacher.response.v1 execution and successful-result replay using the source event_id as idempotency key
  statistic_http: bounded active-learning summary for one exact Student-linked analytics session
  telegram_bot_api: optional signed webhook ingress and outbound plain-text delivery; Dialog remains conversation owner
trust_boundaries:
  api: trusted gateway actor headers with STUDENT or STUDENT_PRO role
  admin: trusted gateway actor headers with ADMIN or MODERATOR role
  internal: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret; routes disabled when token is empty
  telegram_webhook: exact X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token configured with the bot webhook
risks:
  - direct exposure makes actor headers spoofable
  - legacy teacher decisions without learning_action_id cannot be attributed to a new action cycle and are excluded from finalization
  - action-level policy v1 applies recorded assistance context to every target frozen in that action snapshot
  - v1 selected-text lesson mode uses current lesson updated_at and edits invalidate older v1 requests; v2 uses Student frozen immutable revision without mutable fallback
  - production AI Prompt environments must provision and activate teacher.response.v1 in ru and en before action-context traffic is enabled
  - legacy Course and pre-V2 practice actions without authored targets remain readable but targetless; Practice Runtime V2 rejects a targetless revision at Start
  - Practice context is bounded and safe but contains untrusted student code; private evaluation and raw validator output must never cross the boundary
  - Practice validation explanation is optional advisory context; malformed or identity-drifted successful responses fail closed, while explicit unavailable and dependency failure omit only that additive context
  - Practice Runtime accepts the dedicated Teacher credential only on the safe context, validation-explanation, and assistance routes
  - arbitrary soul strings are bounded and treated as untrusted prompt data; they never become system instructions
  - Statistic interesting-activity publication is best effort after in-memory telemetry acceptance; Teacher deduplicates received events but cannot recover observations Statistic never published
  - session summary delivery and Student metric projection are separate idempotent service calls; retry repairs a partial failure without duplicating the Dialog message
  - Telegram Bot API has no caller-supplied idempotency key; delivery is durable and at least once, so an ambiguous network acknowledgement can duplicate a transport message while Dialog history remains singular
  - Learning Planner outcomes are at least once; Teacher accepts Teacher-originated events through an inbox and uses event_id for idempotent Dialog notification
  - product-aware onboarding remains default-dark; invalid/stale Planner readiness blocks without Student finalization, planning mutation, or cursor advance
  - onboarding handoff remains independently default-dark; Planner ACCEPTED records only historical non-executable admission and S9 must revalidate before any effect
  - Next Best Action remains independently default-dark; malformed or unavailable Student NBA state fails closed without a fallback or model call
